## Names

<a id="music_instruments"></a>
### [`music_instruments`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L8) `$E80A-$E849`

*data*

8 instruments of 8 bytes: AD, SR for articulation 0 (normal), AD, SR for articulation 1 (staccato), AD, SR for articulation 2 (legato), 2 unused bytes. Command $Bn selects instrument n. The title tune uses instruments 0, 3 and 5.

- **Referred to by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E731`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L633), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E740`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L641), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E74F`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L649), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E782`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L679), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E789`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L682), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E790`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L685), [`music_note_length`](music_player.md#music_note_length) [`$E795`](../../../src/music_player.asm#L688)
- **Entry of:** [`music_song_table`](../tables.md#music_song_table)

<a id="music_filter_presets"></a>
### [`music_filter_presets`](../../../src/music_data.asm#L19) `$E84A-$E869`

*data*

8 filter presets of 4 bytes: cutoff low ($D415), cutoff high ($D416), resonance in the high nibble ($D417), filter mode ($10 low pass, $20 band pass, $40 high pass) for $D418. Command $Dn.
